name: Lagrange L2 Part2 D-Side
original_name: ラグランジュL2 PART2 D-SIDE
source:
Game starts in the shuttle right after the end of Lagrange L2. The breath is relieved now but the first challenge is already there - the need to escape from missiles of approaching Zera enemy.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事紧接《拉格朗日L2》的结局，在航天飞机中展开。众人刚松一口气，第一道难关便已迫近：他们必须躲过泽拉军迎面射来的导弹。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
